lines.text: خبز عربي - خبز فرنجي - حلويات - بصراوي
lines.latin: Khubz 'Arabi - Khubz Faranji - Halawiyyat - Basrawi (Arab bread, French bread, sweets, Basrawi)

notes: Bakery sign in Amman, frontal. The small words كعك (top right) and بصراوي (top left) flank the name. The blue perfume/watch sign 'حدائق ال...' (cut off) is a distractor; the man in the lower right corner is incidental.

author: young shanahan
attribution: Photo: young shanahan, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/14759783@N04/14111030308. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green Amman street-name blade with house-number range plate below (numbers 1 to 62, arrow pointing left). The Arabic has a spaced dot after ش (abbreviation of شارع).

author: Faris El-Gwely
attribution: Photo: Faris El-Gwely, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Traffic_sign-Jordan_01.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue advance-direction sign near the Dead Sea: brown tourist panel for the Baptism Site (al-Maghtas) on a U-turn arrow, Amman straight on with route shields 40 (white) and 65 (green); 150 m in both Latin and Arabic-Indic digits. Election posters stuck on the lower edge. Gucci billboard behind is a distractor.

author: Faris knight
attribution: Photo: Faris knight, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Traffic_sign-Jordan_02.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Arrow-shaped blue direction sign on a mountain road, photographed from a moving car. Handwritten graffiti over the start of 'Mount Nebo' (not transcribed). The small brown sign below ('مكاور / Mukawir', also graffitied) is a distractor.

author: Daniel Case
attribution: Photo: Daniel Case, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Manaseer_station_sign_along_Desert_Highway_near_Wadi_Rum.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Fuel-station pylon on the Desert Highway near Wadi Rum; target is the brand panel under the sun logo. The price rows (Unleaded 95 / Unleaded 90 / Diesel / Kerosene with LED prices), 'Service', 'Petromin Oils' and 'Car Wash' panels are not transcribed (prices are LED digits, first digit of the top one faint).
source_title: File:Manaseer station sign along Desert Highway near Wadi Rum.jpg

author: mikecogh
attribution: Photo: mikecogh, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/89165847@N00/5920918306. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Perfume-shop sign in Amman. The name carries a kasra under ط and a sukun over the final ب as printed (الطِيبْ). 'BULA FIJI' appears twice (lower left and lower right). The white standing sign below (الطّيب ... عرض خاص ... اشتري زجاجتين) is a promo distractor; perfume bottle images are not text.

author: hikinginjordan
attribution: Photo: hikinginjordan, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:01_Wadi_Bin_Hammad_Tropical_Rain_Forest_Trail_-_Signage_Posts_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Brown tourist direction sign (right arrow). The first Arabic word is partly hidden by pine branches: only its ending '...مات' is visible (presumably حمامات, hot springs), so line 1 transcribes only the legible part. The blue sign at left (At Tafila / Al Karak / Rakin / Batir / Wadi 'Ibn Hammad) is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:01 Wadi Bin Hammad Tropical Rain Forest Trail - Signage Posts - panoramio.jpg

author: alazaat
attribution: Photo: alazaat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/21543443@N00/9947820715. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Old blue enamel shop board over a shuttered front in Amman. 'Co.' has a small raised o. Not transcribed: the two light-blue ovals listing products (paint supplies), the P.O. box '(٥٣٨) ص.ب', phone numbers 622556 / 891745 (also in Arabic-Indic), and the faded cream strip at the bottom (illegible). Blue sign at right edge is cut off (distractor).

author: alazaat
attribution: Photo: alazaat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/21543443@N00/9947813985. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted photo studio sign in Amman: red 'ستوديو' on top, blue 'الساحه / الهاشميه' below, Kodak logo on the left. The sign spells both words with final ه, not ة (standard spelling 'الساحة الهاشمية', the plaza name). The painted film box (Kodak PRINT FILM, Kodacolor 36 EXP., Arabic 'فيلم كوداك') is a product drawing and the blue strip below is a different, mostly hidden sign; both are distractors.

author: alazaat
attribution: Photo: alazaat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/21543443@N00/9947829595. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow bilingual hotel plate on a stone wall in Amman, frontal and sharp. The 'K' roundels in the blue balcony railing above are decoration, not text to read.

lines.latin: Masna' wa Ma'rad Shantat al-Sharq (Al-Sharq Bags Factory and Showroom)

lines.text: لصنع ومبيع جميع أنواع الحقائب الجلدية «جملة ومفرق»
lines.latin: li-sun' wa mabi' jami' anwa' al-haqa'ib al-jildiya (jumla wa mufarraq) (making and selling all kinds of leather bags, wholesale and retail)
lil-madaris / lil-safar / li-rijal al-a'mal (for schools / travel / businessmen)
taslih jami' anwa' al-haqa'ib (repair of all kinds of bags)

notes: Weathered red painted shop sign in Amman, partly in diagonal shadow; heading is in stylised calligraphy (the alif-lam of 'الشرق' is merged into the flourish). Bottom row: '١٨٣٨٠١' follows an envelope icon (P.O. Box); the telephone number after the phone icon is in shadow and too faded to read with certainty, so it is omitted. Not transcribed: a tiny painter's signature under 'مصنع', and the yellow roundel on the left ('لطفاً: دخلة خاصة ممنوع الوقوف', private entrance, no parking), which is a distractor.

author: hikinginjordan
attribution: Photo: hikinginjordan, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:01_Little_Petra_Canyon_Trail_-_Traffic_Sign_to_the_Site_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue directional sign with an up arrow on the road to Siq al-Barid (Little Petra), sign at right of frame. White graffiti scrawls over the English line and peeling paint. Curve-warning and no-overtaking signs are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:01 Little Petra Canyon Trail - Traffic Sign to the Site - panoramio.jpg
source_categories: Curve warning road signs in Jordan
